apiInfo.biography: 字文远，魏雁门马邑人。官至前将军、征东将军、晋阳侯。武功高强，又谋略过人，多次建立奇功，以八百人突袭孙权十万大军，皆望风披靡。
apiInfo.characteristic: 张辽需要尽量多获得一些点数大的手牌。

genderEvidence: Current client474 h=1, same official identity

skills.name: 募兵
skills.text: 出牌阶段开始时，你可以亮出牌堆顶三张牌，然后你可以弃置任意张手牌，获得任意张亮出的牌（你弃置牌的点数之和不得小于你获得牌的点数之和）。
skills.upgradedText: 出牌阶段开始时，你可以亮出牌堆顶四张牌，然后你可以弃置任意张手牌，获得任意张亮出的牌（你弃置牌的点数之和不得小于你获得牌的点数之和），然后你可以将以此法获得的牌以任意方式交给其他角色。

skills.name: 资取
skills.text: 每名角色限一次，当你对其他角色造成伤害时，你可以防止此伤害，令其交给你一张点数最大的牌。

skills.name: 调令
skills.text: 觉醒技，准备阶段，若你以“募兵”累计获得了至少六张【杀】、伤害锦囊牌和武器牌，你回复1点体力或摸两张牌，并修改“募兵”。

interpretation: Current official text permits any number of discarded hand cards with paid rank sum >= obtained rank sum. Semantic inference: zero-card exchanges are allowed and unclaimed reveals go to discard under the existing reveal-cleanup convention.

Diaoling counts actual qualifying acquisitions, not currently held cards. Semantic inference: reacquiring the same physical entity in a later activation counts again and later transfers do not subtract acquisitions. Slash variants, damage tricks including UnexpectedAssault and weapons each count once. No maximum HP reduction is printed.

Upgraded Mubing is current-client spell965.ap: reveal four, first obtain the cards, then optionally distribute any of those still-owned cards among other living players, keeping any remainder. Semantic inference: each acquired entity can be distributed at most once during that activation, even if a nested skill later returns it.

Semantic inference from the current text: Ziqu considers hand and equipment, excludes judgment-zone cards; the actual victim chooses ties privately. No explicit having-cards condition is printed, so an empty victim may still have the damage prevented. These are interpretations, not a separate official FAQ.
Ziqu is once per victim for the owner across skill reacquisition, prevents the entire native damage occurrence, and cannot trigger for source-less or self damage.
validation: Root integrated focused verification passes all four native behavior checks in formal classic identity mode: equal and zero rank exchange, six actual acquisitions and upgraded distribution with no repeated returned entity, actual-source per-victim Ziqu and private tied highest HE choice, actual Silver Lion transfer/recovery with cold native parent return.
